description: Browse county property records, group parcels by recorded owner name, and find available datasets. Preview records, save a search, and check whether your purchased CSV is ready in your account inbox. Weekly checks may find no new records. Added notice, delinquency and municipal data, CAD exports, and estimates of an owner's willingness to sell are unavailable. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

defaultPrompt: Browse Hamilton County, TN property records and show the source and limitations.

publication.release_notes: Version 0.4.4, October 28, 2026: clearer county-record, saved-search, and purchase instructions, complete listing summaries, and updated setup guidance. Existing connections and account permissions are unchanged.

review.commerce_description: GISDB provides MCP tool execution and structured output. It does not process direct in-chat payments.

negative.prompt: Book a roundtrip flight from New York to London for next week.
Transfer $500 from my checking account to my savings account immediately.
Add a dentist appointment to my Google Calendar for 3 PM tomorrow.

positive.description: Test Case 1: County property record search
positive.expected_behavior: Returns available Hamilton County records with their source dates and limitations. Leaves missing facts unknown and makes no claim about willingness to sell.
positive.prompt: Browse Hamilton County, TN property records and show the source and limitations.

positive.description: Test Case 2: Save property search criteria
positive.expected_behavior: Saves the selected search under the connected GISDB account. Shows any returned recurring offer and its terms without starting a purchase or subscription.
positive.prompt: Help me save a property search and explain any available recurring offer before I decide.

positive.description: Test Case 3: Order and delivery status check
positive.expected_behavior: Reopens the selected search and reads the same account-owned order. Reports payment, subscription access and CSV availability separately.
positive.prompt: Resume my GISDB search and check the payment and delivery status of my existing order.

positive.description: Test Case 4: County catalog and coverage check
positive.expected_behavior: Lists returned county records products and source dates. Explains that a directory entry does not mean a package is available to buy.
positive.prompt: What are the data coverage boundaries, source freshness dates, and jurisdiction limits of GISDB?

positive.description: Test Case 5: County dataset metadata inspection
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the returned Hamilton County dataset details, source links, dates and missing facts. Does not infer a current tax year or CAD compatibility.
positive.prompt: Inspect the Hamilton County dataset metadata and show official citations using GISDB.
